title: Positioning: "Darwin" — self-learning evolution, built ON Claude Agent Teams
summary: Product positioning locked as "Darwin": a self-learning, evolving orchestration+memory layer whose category claim is verifiable self-improvement (the work graph IS the memory graph; agents get better as the KB deepens). Claude Agent Teams is the EXECUTION SUBSTRATE we run on — a tailwind/platform, NOT a competitor. We do not position against LangGraph/CrewAI (frameworks to build agents); our competitive set is Tier-2 coding orchestrators (Conductor/Vibe Kanban/Claude Squad) on orchestration and Mem0/Zep/Letta/Cognee on memory. The fusion (memory coupled to execution) + local-first + self-learning harness is the differentiator to own; the open risk is that ON-vs-OFF benefit is still unproven.
